name: Sysmex Corporation
summary: Sysmex Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of diagnostic instruments, reagents, and related software. It offers hematology, a major test routinely included in blood tests; Flow Cytometry (FCM) analyzes cell properties by irradiating individual cells with a laser and measuring the intensity of light scattering and fluorescence; urinalysis test checks for the presence of glucose, proteins, and blood in urine; clinical chemistry; hemostasis; immunochemistry; cancer gene testing; and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.
